name: Tool Crafting, Durability, Repair & Material Processing Runtime
design_rules: tool crafting consumes explicit gathered materials
recipes require sufficient bench tier and labor
crafted quality depends on skill recipe baseline and bench quality
tool durability decreases through use and can reach unusable condition
repair consumes compatible resources and cannot exceed maximum condition
material processing converts raw resources with explicit losses and labor
crafting and processing state persists through inventory and world time
tool crafting never uses emissive or glow feedback
